title: Randy Rides Alone
description: Government agent Randy Bowers (John Wayne) is accused of shooting up a saloon and has to escape from the jail to find the man behind the murders.

title: The Last of the Clintons
description: A cowboy sleuth (Harry Carey) catches rustlers despite a rattlesnake.

title: Raiders of Red Gap
description: The Lone Rider (Bob Livingston) and his sidekick (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) crunch an Arizona grazing-land monopoly.

title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
description: When the Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, the only surviving ranger dons a mask to protect his identity and swears to bring them to justice.

title: Riders of the Deadline
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his pals (Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers) get the drop on Mexican-border gunrunners.

title: Outpost in Morocco
description: A French Foreign Legion captain (George Raft) loves an enemy Arab chieftain's daughter (Marie Windsor).

title: Roll, Thunder, Roll
description: Red Ryder (Jim Bannon) and Little Beaver (Don Kay Reynolds) help a Mexican Robin Hood framed by raiders.

title: Gunsmoke Ranch
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) stop a land swindler out to profit from a flood.

title: A Lust to Kill
description: A marshal (Jim Davis) uses an outlaw's (Don Megowan) girlfriend (Allison Hayes) as bait to lure him into a showdown.

title: Law of the Pampas
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his sidekick (Russell Hayden) head for South America to deliver cattle.

title: Arizona Bound
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) team up to save a woman's stagecoach line from a Mesa City saloon gang.

title: Man From Music Mountain
description: A radio-singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) turns sheriff to save a sheep woman (Ruth Terry) from a cattleman (Paul Kelly).

title: Code of the Fearless
description: A Texas Ranger pretends he has been discharged from service to trick outlaws into accepting him into their gang.

title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
description: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.

title: Frontier Justice
description: A practical joker (Hoot Gibson) rescues his cattleman father from shady sheepmen.

title: Song of Arizona
description: A youth from Gabby Whittaker's (George "Gabby" Hayes) Half-a-Chance Ranch for boys from troubled homes becomes a pawn in the fight between his late father's gang and Roy Rogers.

title: Jesse James Rides Again
description: On the run from the law over false charges, Jesse James and his friend find refuge in a small town threatened by a gang trying to claim the oil deposits beneath it. While there, he meets a pretty woman and father who are in danger.

title: The Way of the West
description: A Mountie moves to a town and begins to stop its illegal activity by busting people one by one.

title: Hell Town
description: A rancher (John Mack Brown) makes his cousin (John Wayne) trail boss on a cattle drive headed for trouble.

title: The Man From Utah
description: A tough cowboy has a head-to-head confrontation with a gang of outlaws using a rodeo as its base of operations.

title: One-Eyed Jacks
description: An ex-convict bandit (Marlon Brando) finds the partner (Karl Malden) who betrayed him is now a town sheriff with a wife (Katy Jurado) and daughter.

title: The Kansan
description: The new marshal (Richard Dix) of a Kansas town cracks down on his sponsor, a greedy banker (Albert Dekker).

title: Colorado Kid
description: A cowboy (Bob Steele) framed for murder breaks out of jail to prove his innocence.

title: Between Men
description: A blacksmith's son (Johnny Mack Brown) goes to New Mexico to find his benefactor's (William Farnum) disinherited granddaughter (Beth Marion).

title: Call of the Forest
description: A young boy's camaraderie with wild animals comes in handy when he sets out to avenge his father's death.

title: Fighting Fury
description: A boy raised by his servant vows to take revenge on the ranchers who killed his parents.

title: Abilene Town
description: A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

title: Fugitive of the Plains
description: Billy the Kid (Buster Crabbe) stages a shootout with outlaws who have transformed an innocent young lady into a wanted desperado.

Herby Bates, who is sweet on Billie Jo, won't be seeing much more of her, he has just been drafted.

description:

description:

description:

description:

description:

Annie (Gail Davis) attempts to prove a beautiful woman (Eve Miller) is involved in two bank robberies. With Rick Vallin.

title: Hands Across the Border

description: A cowboy (John Wayne) romances a pretty woman (Marion Burns) while tracking the outlaw gang that killed his father.

description: Two former Pony Express riders enter a dilapidated stagecoach in a race for a government mail contract.

title: Fighting Caravans
description: A French girl (Lily Damita) joins a wagon train from Missouri led by two scouts and their young partner (Gary Cooper).

A woman arrives in town looking for her son; Roy finds out that her son is not only in the area, but has become a notorious outlaw.

description:

Judge Bean intervenes when the brothers Hart accuse each other of crimes including cattle rustling; the Judge feels something is wrong and wonders about Mr. Welles's involvement.

description:

Bill Davis is killed and the Judge and Jeff track the killers to the Mexico; they are joined by rancher John Gorman, who is suspiciously eager to instantly hang those responsible.

description:

Miguel inherits a silver mine from his father, but two con men stake a claim on it.

description:

The judge tries to do a favor for an old friend, but he finds himself involved in a marriage proposal.

description:

Ah Sid refuses to translate a map brought to him by Fallon and Keats; Ah Sid escapes their attack to be befriended by Judge Roy Bean.

description:

Judge Bean suspects that Doc Malone's medicine show could be harboring a notorious killer.

description:

The Judge sets out to capture an infamous and dangerous train robber who escaped from prison.

description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his pals (Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers) get the drop on Mexican-border gunrunners.

description: After the war with Mexico, cavalry officers try to steal land from Mexican peasants to establish their own empire.

title: Born to Battle
description: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

title: Brothers of the West
description: Detective Tom Wade (Tom Tyler) has to investigate the truth behind a robbery and murder of a bank president that's being blamed on Tom's brother, Ed (Bob Terry), who is nowhere to be found.

title: Sitting Bull
description: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).

title: 'Neath Canadian Skies
description: A Mountie tracks mine robbers in the 1890s Canada.
